svg.title: The directory stack after each part of /a/b/../c/./d/..
svg.desc: Eight panels. '' skip: empty. 'a' push: [a]. 'b' push: [a, b]. '..' pops b: [a]. 'c' push: [a, c]. '.' skip: [a, c]. 'd' push: [a, c, d]. '..' pops d: [a, c]. Result /a/c. Green marks the name just pushed; a red dashed box is the name a '..' popped.
svg.text: simplify_path("/a/b/../c/./d/.."): one panel per part of the split
